comment: The roles of schema 1.6 refused (haumacher/ehome #134, #136, #138): a dimmer needs its command or its level command, at least one; the end positions of a blind are boolean; a climate's heating is boolean or a number, its heating level a number.

refusals.reason: a dimmer needs the role command or levelCommand
datapoint 'position' is real, but the role atTop of a blind takes boolean
the role atBottom of a blind takes boolean
datapoint 'name' is string, but the role heating of a climate takes boolean or a number
datapoint 'on' is boolean, but the role heatingLevel of a climate takes a number
